title: Erkennung personenbezogener Daten
description: As a data protection officer, I want personal data inside prompts to be detected, so that no customer data stays in the registry unnoticed.

acceptance_criteria.given: a developer creates a prompt that contains a customer e-mail address and a customer name
acceptance_criteria.then: the version reaches status FLAGGED with findings of category PII
and: the excerpts are masked and the positions are reported
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-020-pii-detection.feature: Personal data leads to a flagged prompt

acceptance_criteria.given: a developer creates a prompt that contains the address support@example.com
acceptance_criteria.then: a finding of category PII with severity LOW is reported
and: the version is not flagged because the configured threshold is MEDIUM
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-020-pii-detection.feature: Example data stays below the flagging threshold

acceptance_criteria.given: a developer creates a prompt that mentions a customer with a full name in running text
acceptance_criteria.then: a PII finding is reported with the semantic reasoning of the classifier
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-020-pii-detection.feature: Semantic personal data is detected as well
